<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex087032026-06-1506-51-41" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="223.231.111.2 ma 'khrul pa'i don"/>
         ma 'khrul pa'i don ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:5534">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5534">dul la</rs></note> na re mi slu ba yin no zhes zer ro ||<note type="editorial">We take "dul lha" to stand for "dul lha", Vinītadeva (ID:5534). Cf. also Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 182,14 slob dpon dul ba lhas ni rnam rig pa'i grub mtha' ltar mi bslu ba la 'dod pa dang |. See NBV D 4230 4b5 mdo sde pa dang | rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rjes su snyegs par rtsom par 'dod la | gnyi ga yang thob par byed pa'i yul la mi slu ba'i mtshan nyid la ni ma 'khrul ba yin par khas lan to ||</note></seg></TEI>
